final: WITH r AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount AS c FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), t AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot, COUNT(*) AS n FROM r) SELECT r.zoneref AS site_code, r.c AS feature_count, CAST(r.c AS REAL)/t.tot AS share, CAST(r.c AS REAL)/t.tot - 1.0/t.n AS margin_above_avg FROM r, t WHERE CAST(r.c AS REAL)/t.tot > 1.0/t.n ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
